name: fsot-living-scalar-organism
description: FSOT-native evolving intelligence — scalar substrate, genetic guidance, cognitive task fitness

scripts.genetic:check: node -e "const g=require('./fsot_genetic_data'); const b=g.loadGeneticBundle(); console.log(b.loaded); console.log('genome', b.organism&&b.organism.sequence.join('-'));"
scripts.test: node -e "const s=require('./fsot_scalar'); const q=s.computeForDomain('quantum'); const c=s.computeForDomain('cosmological'); if(!(q.S>0)) process.exit(1); if(!(c.S<0)) process.exit(1); const g=require('./fsot_genetic_data').loadGeneticBundle(); if(!g.loaded.codons) process.exit(2); console.log('OK', {quantum:q.S, cosmological:c.S, codons:g.loaded.codons, aa:g.loaded.amino, genome:g.loaded.genome});"

author: Damian Arthur Palumbo
